correctness.rationale: Orthonormalization gives v=alpha^2/[(2alpha+1)(alpha+1)^2]>0 and exact continuous symmetric kernel. Convexity of its Lebesgue function in u=x^alpha reduces to x=0,1; explicit one-sign-change integrations produce both norms. The first endpoint strictly decreases while second strictly increases and they meet at alpha=1; the unique sharp 5/3 minimum and strict endpoint localization follow. Christoffel diagonal is a convex quadratic in u and gives stated endpoint peaks. Limits follow by elementary logarithms. Independent standard-library quadrature and identity checks passed 354 assertions; experiments are not proofs for all alpha.

value.rationale: The natural one-parameter deformation of affine least-squares projection is completely classified: the unique least-amplifying exponent, which endpoint governs worst-case stability, and opposite singular growth of the uniform projector norm versus diagonal Christoffel peak. This answers a motivated optimal-stability question and distinguishes deterministic from Christoffel-based sampling conditioning, beyond merely evaluating an arbitrary exponent or the known affine value.
